issues.description: The visibility of the controller method getAllPersons differs between the template and the solution. The template declares the handler as public (allowing it to be a standard Spring MVC endpoint), while the solution declares it as private. This inconsistency may confuse students about the required visibility for request-handling methods and could lead to unexpected behaviour or difficulty when comparing their implementation to the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the handler method visibility consistent. Prefer changing the solution implementation to declare getAllPersons as public to match the template and the conventional Spring controller method visibility (i.e., replace 'private ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons()' with 'public ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons()').
